text:
Maria K: Heads-up — proposing a sticky-pin exemption for runtime-3.2.1 for the llamaX longseq pool. We hit a regression in kvcache interactions on 3.2.2; ops and infra want to keep 3.2.1 pinned in the longseq canary until we can rollforward safely.

Aj Patel: Can you summarize the criteria for lifting the stickiness? curious about rollback vs rollforward path. :eyes:

Maria K: TL;DR: keep 3.2.1 pinned on longseq canary for the next 6h change window while we push a telemetry fix to 3.2.3. Exemption = prevent automated unpin by deploybot during scheduled unpin window. Lift when: 1) 3.2.3 canary shows stable p95 latency delta < 5% over baseline for 30m AND 2) error rate (5xx) < 0.5% in same window.

Ryan C: Props for clear criteria. For rollback rules — if we see error rate > 2% for 5 consecutive mins OR sustained p95 > 500ms for 10m, autosystems should rollback to 3.2.1 and open paging. Confirming deploybot can do sticky exemptions?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Accepted commands: `/deploy pin <target> --scope=<scope> --sticky-exempt` and `/deploy unpin <target> --force`

Maria K: Example command we plan to run now:
```
/deploy pin runtime=runtime-3.2.1 --scope=longseq-canary --sticky-exempt --reason="kvcache regression mitigation"
```

Sasha L: QA will run the longseq perf harness against 3.2.3 as soon as it's up. Olivia, can you schedule a 30m smoke run starting at 14:30 UTC? If harness passes we'll signal rollforward.

Olivia QA: Yep — scheduled 14:30-15:00 UTC. I'll post the harness link and a short checklist.

Aj Patel: What about SDK compatibility? We had a minor protocol change in 3.2.3 that could affect older SDKs. We should gate on the SDK matrix: at least 90% of live SDKs must report no protocol errors in canary traffic.

Maria K: Good catch. Ops will add a simple telemetry tag for protocol-mismatch errors. We'll also add a temporary routing rule so mobile-sdk traffic goes to dedicated stable pool until we verify.

Ryan C: One more ops safeguard: set a soft-fallback policy for the next 24h that routes to smaller-quantized variant (runtime-3.1.9-q) if p95 spikes > 2x baseline. That avoids wholesale rollback for mild regressions.

Maria K: Agree. Plan summary: 1) pin runtime-3.2.1 with sticky-exempt on longseq-canary now. 2) push 3.2.3 canary + QA harness at 14:30 UTC. 3) monitor metrics for 30-60m. 4) if criteria met, run `/deploy unpin runtime-3.2.1 --scope=longseq-canary` and rollforward. If failure triggers, deploybot + autosystems rollback to 3.2.1 automatically.

Sasha L: 👍 Please add the runbook steps to the incident doc (link later). Also call out the rollback pager policy.

Maria K: Will update the runbook and ping on #oncall. Anyone object to starting the pin now?

Aj Patel: No objections from infra. :thumbsup:

Ryan C: Fine with me. Also tagging @sre oncall to keep eyes.

Olivia QA: No objections. I have the harness ready.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Executing: `/deploy pin runtime=runtime-3.2.1 --scope=longseq-canary --sticky-exempt --reason="kvcache regression mitigation"`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Success — runtime-3.2.1 pinned on longseq-canary. Pin ID: pin-2026-03-20-01.

Maria K: Thanks — I'll update the rollout doc and post telemetry links once 3.2.3 is up. Leaving this thread open for status updates. :wave:

Ryan C: If we hit any noisy signals, please tag me and I'll evaluate emergency rollback.

Sasha L: Posted runbook link: https://wiki.internal/redwood/rollforward-runbooks/longseq-kvcache. Added checklist and pager matrix.

Olivia QA: Harness started (14:30 UTC). Link: https://ci/redwood/longseq-harness/98765 — I'll report results in 30m.

Maria K: Noted — thanks everyone.

Olivia QA: 14:45 UTC — initial 15m pass looks good: p95 delta = +1.8%, error rate = 0.12%. Continuing to 15:00.

Ryan C: Nice. Keep monitoring for anomaly counts.

Olivia QA: 15:02 UTC — full 30m pass completed. No protocol-mismatch events, SDK matrix shows 94% coverage with no errors.

Maria K: Given pass, preparing to unpin in 10 mins unless objections.

Aj Patel: go for it.

Sasha L: go ahead from QA side.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Executing: `/deploy unpin runtime=runtime-3.2.1 --scope=longseq-canary`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Success — unpinned runtime-3.2.1 on longseq-canary. Pin ID pin-2026-03-20-01 retired.

Maria K: Rollforward to 3.2.3 now enabled. I'll keep an eye for the next 2 hours. Thanks team. :rocket:
